summary: vm-exec.bash teaches one caller of the ws-image probe to report a non-zero status, but bin/subcommands/export still reads every non-zero status as "no image packed yet".

must_flag.why: line 110 reads any non-zero exit of _GLOVEBOX_VM_WSIMAGE as "no workspace", the same defect the diff just fixed in the sibling caller — an unreadable probe now silently reports a lost workspace as none.
